questions.question: Which method can be used to manually request a refresh of the content cards?
questions.explanation: The requestContentCardsRefresh() method allows manual refresh of content cards in the Web SDK.

questions.question: Which code snippet will italicize the in-app message header?
questions.explanation: Using CSS with the selector body .ab-in-app-message .ab-message-header and font-style: italic will italicize the header.
